claim: The engine loads a DDS file where the vanilla UI names a .tga, so upscaled TGA art could carry a DDS mip chain
notes: run 2026-11-06_j96 art2, 4-aligned re-probe: the confound is gone, 'refuted' stands. A DXT5 with a full mip chain at all 9 button_steam_store*.tga paths (148x24, on screen) leaves the Steam button blank: the text stays, the gold art is gone, and J50's TGA at the same paths drew magenta. The 364 aligned ui\battle ui\skins files (one pack with TGA controls that drew) show no orange: pixels they own are blank or keep a look underneath. Both probes' sizes: 500x153 (J50) and 148x24 (J96), both blank. Earlier note: run 2026-10-31_j50 probe s2d: a DXT5 DDS with a full mip chain (9 levels) at ui\frontend ui\skins\logo.tga in a movie pack: the logo is not drawn (blank), where a TGA at the same path in the same kind of pack is drawn; no crash; no proxy log line (the proxy has no texture hook). J36 TGA-stays-TGA stands: the UI host builds mips. Confound (J50 review round 1): logo.tga is 500x153 and the probe DXT5 was written unpadded, and D3D9 wants DXT top-level sizes in multiples of 4, so 'blank' may be the texture refused, not the path; the only 4-aligned probe (button_steam_store, 148x24) was not the file on screen. Vanilla has one unaligned DXT1 (ui\loading_screen_pictures\2.dds, 1921x1200). Re-probe with a 4-aligned on-screen TGA before relying on 'no'
